mapper.select: SELECT feature_code, enabled, version FROM public.iam_tenant_feature WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND is_deleted=false ORDER BY feature_code

SELECT permission.id AS permission_id, permission.parent_id, permission.permission_code, permission.name, permission.route_path, permission.feature_code, CASE WHEN permission.feature_code IS NULL THEN true ELSE COALESCE(feature.enabled, false) END AS feature_enabled, config.hidden AS tenant_hidden, config.version AS tenant_version, COALESCE(preference.hidden, false) AS personally_hidden, preference.version AS preference_version, permission.sort_order FROM public.iam_permission_resource permission JOIN public.iam_tenant_menu_config config ON config.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND config.menu_permission_id=permission.id AND config.is_deleted=false LEFT JOIN public.iam_tenant_feature feature ON feature.tenant_id=config.tenant_id AND feature.feature_code=permission.feature_code AND feature.is_deleted=false LEFT JOIN public.iam_account_menu_preference preference ON preference.tenant_id=config.tenant_id AND preference.account_id=#{accountId} AND preference.menu_permission_id=permission.id AND preference.is_deleted=false WHERE permission.app_code='TENANT_ADMIN' AND permission.resource_type IN ('DIRECTORY','MENU') AND permission.publish_status='PUBLISHED' AND permission.is_deleted=false ORDER BY permission.sort_order, permission.id
mapper.update: UPDATE public.iam_tenant_feature SET enabled=#{enabled}, changed_by=#{operatorId}, updated_by=#{operatorId}, updated_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, version=version+1 WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND feature_code=#{featureCode} AND version=#{version} AND is_deleted=false

UPDATE public.iam_tenant_menu_config config SET hidden=#{hidden}, changed_by=#{operatorId}, updated_by=#{operatorId}, updated_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, version=config.version+1 FROM public.iam_permission_resource permission WHERE config.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND config.menu_permission_id=permission.id AND permission.permission_code=#{permissionCode} AND permission.app_code='TENANT_ADMIN' AND permission.resource_type IN ('DIRECTORY','MENU') AND permission.publish_status='PUBLISHED' AND permission.is_deleted=false AND config.version=#{version} AND config.is_deleted=false

UPDATE public.iam_account_menu_preference preference SET hidden=#{hidden}, updated_by=#{accountId}, updated_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, version=preference.version+1 FROM public.iam_permission_resource permission WHERE preference.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND preference.organization_id=#{organizationId} AND preference.account_id=#{accountId} AND preference.menu_permission_id=permission.id AND permission.permission_code=#{permissionCode} AND permission.app_code='TENANT_ADMIN' AND permission.resource_type IN ('DIRECTORY','MENU') AND permission.publish_status='PUBLISHED' AND permission.is_deleted=false AND preference.version=#{version} AND preference.is_deleted=false
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO public.iam_account_menu_preference ( id,tenant_id,organization_id,account_id,menu_permission_id,hidden,created_by,updated_by ) SELECT nextval('public.iam_account_menu_preference_seq'),#{tenantId},#{organizationId},#{accountId}, permission.id,#{hidden},#{accountId},#{accountId} FROM public.iam_permission_resource permission WHERE permission.permission_code=#{permissionCode} AND permission.app_code='TENANT_ADMIN' AND permission.resource_type IN ('DIRECTORY','MENU') AND permission.publish_status='PUBLISHED' AND permission.is_deleted=false
mapper.update: UPDATE public.iam_account SET authz_version=authz_version+1, updated_by=#{operatorId}, updated_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, version=version+1 WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND status IN ('ACTIVE','PASSWORD_RESET_REQUIRED') AND is_deleted=false
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO public.iam_outbox_event ( id,event_id,aggregate_type,aggregate_id,tenant_id,event_type,payload_json,status,created_by,updated_by ) SELECT nextval('public.iam_outbox_event_seq'), md5(random()::text || clock_timestamp()::text || account.id::text), 'TENANT_ACCOUNT',CAST(account.id AS varchar),#{tenantId},'SESSION_INVALIDATION_REQUESTED', jsonb_build_object('accountId',CAST(account.id AS varchar),'tenantId',CAST(#{tenantId} AS varchar), 'actionNameSnapshot',#{actionName},'usernameSnapshot',account.username, 'displayNameSnapshot',COALESCE(account.display_name,account.username),'ipAddress',#{ipAddress}), 'PENDING',#{operatorId},#{operatorId} FROM public.iam_account account WHERE account.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND account.status IN ('ACTIVE','PASSWORD_RESET_REQUIRED') AND account.is_deleted=false
